layers.name: base
layers.content:
# Base configuration
APP_NAME=platform-api
APP_ENV=production
SERVICE_URL=https://${APP_DOMAIN}/api/v2
APP_DOMAIN=api.example.com
LOG_LEVEL=warn
DB_HOST=db-prod.internal
DB_PORT=5432
DB_NAME=platform_db
DB_URL="postgresql://${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}"
API_KEY="sk-prod-abc123"
SSL_CERT_PATH=/etc/ssl/certs/app.pem
internal_note=this-should-export

layers.name: deployment
layers.content:
# Deployment overrides
APP_DOMAIN=prod.platform.io
REPLICAS=3
MEMORY_LIMIT=2048
HEALTH_CHECK_PATH="/healthz"
DEPLOY_NOTES="canary release v2.8.1"
SSH_BANNER="Welcome to production server.
Authorized access only.
All sessions are monitored and recorded.
Disconnect immediately if unauthorized."
HEALTH_ENDPOINT=${SERVICE_URL}/health
